summary_of_bug: ArrayUtils.addAll(T[] array1, T... array2) mishandles mixed array component types. It should successfully combine compatible arrays into a common supertype array, e.g. Integer[] + Long[] assigned to Number[] should produce a Number[] of length 2, but when the first array’s component type is too narrow, e.g. Integer[] + Long[], it currently fails with a low-level ArrayStoreException from System.arraycopy instead of a clear IllegalArgumentException.
